overview_description.description: FinFlx is a workplace financial wellness platform that helps SMEs in designing and delivering financial benefits on a large scale. It provides a variety of savings plans for people with varying risk tolerances, including a capital protection plan that guarantees the principal amount. They  use cutting-edge technology to transform the way businesses manage gratuity from spreadsheets and paperwork to an accessible, user-friendly platform that empowers the future of work and finance. FinFlx creates a healthy balance sheet for your company by separating gratuity funds from operational cash flow.
